verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Sooratun anzalnaahaa wa faradnaahaa wa anzalnaa feehaa aayaatin bayyinaatin la-allakum tadhakkaroon

Az-zaaniyatu waz-zaanee fajlidoo kulla waahidin minhumaa miaa'ata jaldatin wa laa ta'khudhkum bihimaa ra'fatun fee deenillaahi in kuntum tu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa lyashhad adhaabahumaa taa'ifatun minal-mu'mineen
Az-zaanee laa yankihu illaa zaaniyatan aw mushrikatan waz-zaaniyatu laa yankihuhaa illaa zaanin aw mushrikun wa hurrima dhaalika alal-mu'mineen
Wal-ladheena yarmoonal-muhsanaati thumma lam ya'too bi-arba'ati shuhadaa'a fajlidoohum thamaaneena jaldatan wa laa taqbaloo lahum shahaadatan abadan wa ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Illal-ladheena taaboo min ba'di dhaalika wa aslahoo fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Wal-ladheena yarmoona azwaajahum wa lam yakun lahum shuhadaa'u illaa anfusuhum fashahaadatu ahadihim arba'u shahaadaatin Billaahi innahu laminas-saadiqeen
Wal-khaamisatu anna la'nata Allaahi alayhi in kaana minal-kaadhibeen
Wa yadra'u anhal-adhaaba an tashhada arba'a shahaadaatin Billaahi innahu laminal-kaadhibeen
Wal-khaamisata anna ghadaba Allaahi alayhaa in kaana minas-saadiqeen
Wa lawlaa fadlu Allaahi alaykum wa rahmatuhu wa annallaaha tawwaabun hakeem
Innal-ladheena jaa'oo bil-ifki usbatun minkum laa tahsaboohu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli imri'in minhum mak-tasaba minal-ithmi wal-ladhee tawallaa kibrahu minhum lahu adhaabun azeem
Lawlaa idh sami'tumoohu zannal-mu'minoona wal-mu'minaatu bi-anfusihim khayran wa qaaloo haadhaa ifkun mubeen
Lawlaa jaa'oo alayhi bi-arba'ati shuhadaa'a fa-idh lam ya'too bish-shuhadaa'i fa-ulaa'ika indallaahi humul-kaadhiboon
Wa lawlaa fadlu Allaahi alaykum wa rahmatuhu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati lamassakum fee maa afadtum feehi adhaabun azeem
Idh talaqqawnahu bi-alsinatikum wa taqooloona bi-afwaahikum maa laysa lakum bihi ilmun wa tahsaboonahu hayyinan wa huwa indallaahi azeem
Wa lawlaa idh sami'tumoohu qultum maa yakoonu lanaa an natakallama bihadhaa subhaanaka haadhaa buhtaanun azeem
Ya'izukumu Allaahu an ta'oodoo limithlihi abadan in kuntum mu'mineen
Wa yubayyinu Allaahu lakumul-aayaati Wallaahu aleemun hakeem
Innal-ladheena yuhibboona an tashee'al-faahishatu fil-ladheena aamanoo lahum adhaabun aleemun fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati Wallaahu ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon
Wa lawlaa fadlu Allaahi alaykum wa rahmatuhu wa annallaaha ra'oofun Raheem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaani wa man yattabi khutuwaatish-shaytaani fa-innahu ya'muru bil-fahshaa'i wal-munkari wa lawlaa fadlu Allaahi alaykum wa rahmatuhu maa zakaa minkum min ahadin abadan wa laakinna Allaaha yuzakkee man yashaa'u Wallaahu samee'un aleem

Wa laa ya'tali ulul-fadli minkum was-sa'ati an yu'too ulil-qurbaa wal-masaakeena wal-muhaajireena fee sabeelillaahi wa lya'foo wa lyasfahoo alaa tuhibboona an yaghfira Allaahu lakum Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Innal-ladheena yarmoonal-muhsanaatil-ghaafilaatil-mu'minaati lu'inoo fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa lahum adhaabun azeem
Yawma tashhadu alayhim alsinatuhum wa aydeehim wa arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Yawma'idhin yuwaffeehimu Allaahu deenahumul-haqqa wa ya'lamoona annallaaha huwal-haqqul-mubeen
Al-khabeethaatu lilkhabeetheena wal-khabeethoona lilkhabeethaati wat-tayyibaatu lit-tayyibeena wat-tayyiboona lit-tayyibaati ulaa'ika mubarra'oona mimmaa yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun wa rizqun kareem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hattaa tasta'nisoo wa tusallimoo alaa ahlihaa dhaalikum khayrun lakum la-allakum tadhakkaroon
Fa-in lam tajidoo feehaa ahadan falaa tadkhuloohaa hattaa yu'udhana lakum wa in qeela lakum irji'oo farji'oo huwa azkaa lakum Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona aleem
Laysa alaykum junaahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feehaa mataa'un lakum Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wa maa taktumoon
Qul lilmu'mineena yaghuddoo min absaarihim wa yahfazoo furoojahum dhaalika azkaa lahum innallaaha khabeerun bimaa yasna'oon

Wa qul lilmu'minaati yaghdudna min absaarihinna wa yahfazna furoojahunna wa laa yubdeena zeenatahunna illaa maa zahara minhaa wa lyadribna bikhumurihinna alaa juyoobihinna wa laa yubdeena zeenatahunna illaa libu'oolatihinna aw aabaa'ihinna aw aabaa'i bu'oolatihinna aw abnaa'ihinna aw abnaa'i bu'oolatihinna aw ikhwaanihinna aw banee ikhwaanihinna aw banee akhawaatihinna aw nisaa'ihinna aw maa malakat aymaanuhunna awit-taabi'eena ghayri ulil-irbati minar-rijaali awit-tiflil-ladheena lam yazharoo alaa awraatin-nisaa wa laa yadribna bi-arjulihinna liyu'lama maa yukhfeena min zeenatihinna wa tooboo ilaa Allaahi jamee'an ayyuhal-mu'minoona la-allakum tuflihoon
Wa ankihul-ayaamaa minkum was-saaliheena min ibaadikum wa imaa'ikum in yakoonoo fuqaraa'a yughnihimu Allaahu min fadlihi Wallaahu waasi'un aleem

Wa lyasta'fifil-ladheena laa yajidoona nikaahan hattaa yughniyahumu Allaahu min fadlihi wal-ladheena yabtaghoonal-kitaaba mimmaa malakat aymaanukum fakaatiboohum in alimtum feehim khayran wa aatoohum min maali Allaahil-ladhee aataakum wa laa tukrihoo fatayaatikum alal-bighaa'i in aradna tahassunan litabtaghoo aradal-hayaatid-dunyaa wa man yukrihhunna fa-innallaaha min ba'di ikraahihinna ghafoorun Raheem
Wa laqad anzalnaa ilaykum aayaatin mubayyinaatin wa mathalan minal-ladheena khalaw min qablikum wa maw'izatan lilmuttaqeen

Allaahu noorus-samaawaati wal-ardi mathalu noorihi kamishkaatin feehaa misbaahun al-misbaahu fee zujaajatin az-zujaajatu ka'annahaa kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubaarakatin zaytooniatin laa sharqiyyatin wa laa gharbiyyatin yakaadu zaytuhaa yudee'u wa law lam tamsashu naarun noorun alaa noorin yahdee Allaahu linoorihi man yashaa'u wa yadribu Allaahul-amthaala lin-naasi Wallaahu bikulli shay'in aleem
Fee buyootin adhina Allaahu an turfa'a wa yudhkara feehas-muhu yusabbihu lahu feehaa bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaal
Rijaalun laa tulheehim tijaaratun wa laa bay'un an dhikri Allaahi wa iqaamis-salaati wa eetaa'iz-zakaati yakhaafoona yawman tataqallabu feehil-quloobu wal-absaar
Liyajziyahumu Allaahu ahsana maa amiloo wa yazeedahum min fadlihi Wallaahu yarzuqu man yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Wal-ladheena kafaroo a'maaluhum kasaraabin biqee'atin yahsabuhuz-zam'aanu maa'an hattaa idhaa jaa'ahu lam yajidhu shay'an wa wajada Allaaha indahu fawaffaahu hisaabahu Wallaahu saree'ul-hisaab

Aw kazulumaatin fee bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshaahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi sahaabun zulumaatun ba'duhaa fawqa ba'din idhaa akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraahaa wa man lam yaj'ali Allaahu lahu nooran famaa lahu min noor
Alam taraa annallaaha yusabbihu lahu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wat-tayru saaffaatin kullun qad alima salaatahu wa tasbeehahu Wallaahu aleemun bimaa yaf'aloon
Wa Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa ilaa Allaahil-maseer

Alam taraa annallaaha yuzjee sahaaban thumma yu'uallifu baynahu thumma yaj'aluhu rukaaman fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalihi wa yunazzilu minas-samaa'i min jibaalin feehaa min baradin fayuseebu bihi man yashaa'u wa yasrifuhu an man yashaa'u yakaadu sanaa barqihi yadhhabu bil-absaar
Yuqallibu Allaahul-layla wan-nahaara inna fee dhaalika la-ibratan li'wlil-absaar

Wallaahu khalaqa kulla daabbatin min maa'in faminhum man yamshee alaa batnihi wa minhum man yamshee alaa rijlayni wa minhum man yamshee alaa arba'in yakhluqu Allaahu maa yashaa'u innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Laqad anzalnaa aayaatin mubayyinaatin Wallaahu yahdee man yashaa'u ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Wa yaqooloona aamannaa Billaahi wa bir-rasooli wa ata'naa thumma yatawallaa fareequn minhum min ba'di dhaalika wa maa ulaa'ika bil-mu'mineen
Wa idhaa du'oo ilaa Allaahi wa rasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum idhaa fareequn minhum mu'ridoon
Wa in yakun lahumul-haqqu ya'too ilayhi mudh'ineen
Afee quloobihim maradun am irtaaboo am yakhaafoona an yaheefa Allaahu alayhim wa rasooluhu bal ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
Innamaa kaana qawlal-mu'mineena idhaa du'oo ilaa Allaahi wa rasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqooloo sami'naa wa ata'naa wa ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wa man yuti'i Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa yakhsha Allaaha wa yattaqhi fa-ulaa'ika humul-faa'izoon
Wa aqsamoo Billaahi jahda aymaanihim la-in amartahum layakhrujunna qul laa tuqsimoo taa'atun ma'roofatun innallaaha khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon
Qul atee'oo Allaaha wa atee'ur-rasoola fa-in tawallaw fa-innamaa alayhi maa hummila wa alaykum maa hummiltum wa in tutee'oohu tahtadoo wa maa alar-rasooli illal-balaaghul-mubeen

Wa-ada Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo minkum wa amilus-saalihaati layastakhlifannahum fil-ardi kamas-takhlafal-ladheena min qablihim wa layumakkinanna lahum deenahumul-ladhee irtadaa lahum wa layubaddilannahum min ba'di khawfihim amnan ya'budoonanee laa yushrikoona bee shay'an wa man kafara ba'da dhaalika fa-ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Wa aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata wa atee'ur-rasoola la-allakum turhamoon
Laa tahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo mu'jizeena fil-ardi wa ma'waahumun-naaru wa labi'sal-maseer

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo liyasta'dhinkumul-ladheena malakat aymaanukum wal-ladheena lam yablughul-huluma minkum thalaatha marraatin min qabli salaatil-fajri wa heena tada'oona thiyaa bakum minaz-zaheerati wa min ba'di salaatil-ishaa'i thalaathu awraatin lakum laysa alaykum wa laa alayhim junaahun ba'dahunna tawwaafoona alaykum ba'dukum alaa ba'din kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakumul-aayaa ti Wallaahu aleemun hakeem
Wa idhaa balaghal-atfaalu minkumul-huluma falyasta'dhinoo kamas-ta'dhanal-ladheena min qablihim kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakum aayaatihi Wallaahu aleemun hakeem

Wal-qawaa'idu minan-nisaa al-laatee laa yarjoona nikaahan falaysa alayhinna junaahun an yada'na thiyaabahunna ghayra mutabarrijaatin bizeenatin wa an yasta'fifna khayrun lahunna Wallaahu samee'un aleem

Laysa alal-a'maa harajun wa laa alal-a'raji harajun wa laa alal-mareedi harajun wa laa alaa anfusikum an ta'kuloo min buyootikum aw buyooti aabaa'ikum aw buyooti ummahaatikum aw buyooti ikhwaanikum aw buyooti akhawaatikum aw buyooti a'maamikum aw buyooti ammaatikum aw buyooti akhwaalikum aw buyooti khaalaatikum aw maa malaktum mafaatihahu aw sadeeqikum laysa alaykum junaahun an ta'kuloo jamee'an aw ashtaatan fa-idhaa dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo alaa anfusikum tahiyyatan min indi Allaahi mubaarakatan tayyibatan kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakumul-aayaati la-allakum ta'qiloon

Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena aamanoo Billaahi wa rasoolihi wa idhaa kaanoo ma'ahu alaa amrin jaami'in lam yadhhaboo hattaa yasta'dhinoohu innal-ladheena yasta'dhinoonaka ulaa'ikal-ladheena yu'minoona Billaahi wa rasoolihi fa-idhaa ista'dhanooka liba'di sha'nihim fa'dhan liman shi'ta minhum wastaghfir lahumu Allaaha innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem

Laa taj'aloo du'aa'ar-rasooli baynakum kadu'aa'i ba'dikum ba'dan qad ya'lamu Allaahul-ladheena yatasallaloona minkum liwaadhan falyahdharil-ladheena yukhaalifoona an amrihi an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum adhaabun aleem
Alaa inna Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi qad ya'lamu maa antum alayhi wa yawma yurja'oona ilayhi fayunabbi'uhum bimaa amiloo Wallaahu bikulli shay'in aleem
